Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates given below are the documented PC image-repository revision dates (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V5-D-iamyourfather_ai-2025-01-24-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V5-D-iamyourfather_ai-2022-06-11.png]], 11 June 2022) → [[File:V5-D-iamyourfather_ai-2025-01-24-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V5-D-iamyourfather_ai-2025-01-24.png]], 24 January 2025).
